name: dashboard
title: Simple dashboard
description: Headline figures with a comparison, a trend and a table, from one cube — read-only, each person sees what TM1 allows. For quick, standard dashboards; build a custom Lens for anything more.

settings.heading: The title at the top
settings.subtitle: One line under the title
settings.where: { dimension: member } — the slice every number is read at (version, year, currency…)
settings.pick: { dimension, under | level | members, label, default } — an optional picker, e.g. a region (only what the person may see)
settings.kpis: [{ label, value: { dimension: member }, compare: { dimension: member }, format, cost }] — headline tiles; cost: true when lower is better
settings.compareLabel: What the comparison is called, e.g. Target
settings.trend: { title, dimension, members, series: [{ name, at: { dimension: member }, compare, type }], format, cost } — a chart across periods
settings.table: { title, rows: { dimension, under | level, label }, columns: { dimension, members, labels }, format } — a table
